policy: Only CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public-domain works. No NC or ND licenses, no DUA-gated corpora, no Radiopaedia mirrors.
BY-SA items are served with their license named so any derivative stays BY-SA; cropping or annotation must be recorded in provenance.modifications.
is_synthetic is false for every entry here; a synthetic entry must carry generator, review and C2PA fields before it can be added.
No runtime web search: the resolver only reads this file.
